sources.quote: the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The only approval for BR-220 (Beinasco, Aurelia) is for SUP-B. There is no approval for Meccanica Chisone. The 2026-11-06 re-audit restored the company's standing but did not release any part, so the change cannot go to Chisone.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only. BR-220 is drawn in 6082-T6, yield at least 250.
they can make BR-220 blanks from the same alloy they use for BR-310

findings.why: The drawing requires 6082-T6. Chisone is qualified only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. The phone claim about the BR-310 alloy is unverified and does not show 6082-T6 capability. Nothing newer changes this.

findings.key: 8D cracking on Chisone 6082 material (no issue id in documents)

sources.quote: The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet, corrective action still being verified.
the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.

findings.why: Chisone has an open 8D on 6082 material, which is the alloy of BR-220. It was still open on 2026-11-06, and no later record shows it closed.
